title: Passport application of John Muir, Volume 995: May 1 to 6, 1903
credit: National Archives at College Park, General Records of the Department of State, Passport Applications, Volume 995: May 1 to 6, 1903, NAID 235846313 (images 0420 and 0421; image provided by Fold3).
alt_text: Images of the passport application of John Muir, Year of Birth: 1838, in Volume 995: May 1 to 6, 1903 of the Passport Applications, General Records of the Department of State.
adversary_rationale: The snapshot identifies John Muir, birth year 1838, on images 0420 and 0421 and gives useRestriction.status as Unrestricted; the supplied 1914 death basis satisfies the private-writings exception. Live API and catalog retrieval failed, and web search returned no result.
notes:
